commands.payload:
BlueTusk Streams PostgreSQL tooling

Usage:
  bluetusk-streams validate [options]
  bluetusk-streams provision [options]

Run 'bluetusk-streams <command> --help' for command options.

result.stdout:
Usage: bluetusk-streams validate [options]

Source:
  --connection <value>          Source connection; or BLUETUSK_STREAMS_SOURCE.
  --publication <name>         Publication name; repeatable and required.
  --slot <name>                Logical replication slot name; required.
  --skip-slot                  Skip slot creation; validation reports its absence.

Relay:
  --control-connection <value> Separate control connection; or BLUETUSK_STREAMS_CONTROL.
  --control-schema <name>      Relay schema (default: bluetusk_streams).
  --direct-only                Explicitly provision without durable relay storage.
  --allow-shared-control       Explicitly allow source and control in one database.
